Bio:
Bisa Jackson, or B.J. is a black teacher who teaches in a poor high school called Scottsdale High for the past a few years. She’s very ghetto just like the rest and treats people often poorly or sexually. She’s one of the teachers who has a lack of budget, mostly because she doesn’t really do her job well and doesn’t make much effort to help students learn on the subject she’s teaching. She doesn’t really care about being a teacher, but she only wants to do it for the money and sometimes have sex with the sexy students (who are 18 or higher). Even though she teaches them poorly, she also passes MOST of them anyway. Whoever disrespects her or does something bad to her, she won’t hesitate to fail them…or punish them with her own terms. Most of her students she teaches are blacks and Latinos, a few Natives and rarely Asians. When there’s a fight at school, she doesn’t intervene because she’s afraid. She’s not, but instead, she just watches the students fight each other and they enjoy watching them doing violence and destroying each other for almost no reason. Funny part is, when one student lost and was knocked out, she rewarded the winner to have a secret sex and a lot of times…it worked. Anyway, outside of school, she grew up and still lives in the hood. She rarely does any school education and is not that intelligent, but she has street smarts. Sometimes, when she doesn’t have enough income from the school payments, she’ll occasionally be a prostitute. Find any man to pay her and have sex. Other times, she often sneakily steals from others and gets away with it. Not only does she steal or earn money, but also different items. Besides that, she loves shopping to buy jewelry and other good stuff. She likes to hang out in the hood, play basketball, partying, and sometimes bully weaklings for fun. Even with her homies or her favorite students. Since she’s black, she also does stereotypes…including whooping anyone’s ass who’s racist, even though she uses a lot of slurs towards any race. Overall, Bisa Jackson is a hot chocolate teacher, but still ghetto and careless on her job. Although, only does this for money.
Fun Fact: Bisa has no college degree to become a teacher, she just got hired and took this teaching job at a very poor school.
